runtime_contract.unknown_future_state_policy: Preserve opaque data and refuse mutation.
runtime_contract.contribution_policy: Actual accepted loss/protection/healing/objectives with verified source and run identity; final event references and after-unwind HP/absorption checks.
runtime_contract.reward_policy: Supported items only, authentic Core serial ownership where applicable, bounded separate native-item policy, durable outbox and terminal once-only receipt.
runtime_contract.reset_policy: Only empty owned instances, conditional before/after journal restoration, no blind whole-volume paste over players.
runtime_contract.native_boss_ownership_policy: Actual registry plus entity UUID, dimension, run identity, authenticity and revival outcome; do not reset global biju/vessel managers.
runtime_contract.native_cost_and_xp_policy: Native casts retain their own cost/cooldown/XP pipeline; observation never replays a cast or charges/awards again.
runtime_contract.imported_custom_npcs_policy: Preserve UUID, dialog/faction/quest/clone data, scripts, assets, inventories and event-bus behavior; never repurpose imported actors.

repair_policy: Preserve failed candidates/reports, fix the root cause, regenerate affected outputs and rerun affected/downstream gates. Do not delete assertions, omit an arena or reuse evidence from different bytes.

private: new preview world or reproducible guarded staging package
complete artifact hashes and failure history

completion_truth.expected_behavior: Execute the complete five-arena assignment in one run with self-repair, while stating actual scope and unavailable acceptance honestly.
